description: An object for condition that isn't a bool after an unknown one gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec says the condition must evaluate to a bool, and that unknown values give the dynamic pseudo-type only when they are otherwise type-valid. ForExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) only reports a null or invalid condition while every earlier condition was known, so after an unknown condition it skips the error and returns the dynamic value.
